title: Technology stocks
statementMd:
List the symbols of stocks in the Technology sector.

Expected columns: `symbol`, `company`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT symbol, company FROM tickers WHERE sector = 'Technology';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
